items.title: APT36 Hackers Attacking Indian BOSS Linux Systems With Weaponized .desktop Shortcut Files
items.description: In early August 2025, security researchers uncovered an unprecedented campaign targeting India’s BOSS Linux installations through seemingly innocuous shortcut files. These files, masquerading as PDF documents, leverage the .desktop format intrinsic to Linux desktop environments to deliver and execute malicious payloads.
